categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches P2P label and modifies address management logic in src/addrman.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes a logic bug in AddrMan that mistakenly inflated an address's multiplicity in the new table when identical announcements arrived from multiple peers. As the author notes, this is a minor logic bugfix with limited adversarial impact since attackers can already vary timestamps to manipulate refcounts.
